content: The BswM_J1939DcmBroadcastStatus parameter Net- workMask is a bitmask where the bit position corresponds to the ComMChannel . ComMChannelId which is referenced by the BswMJ1939DcmBroadcastStatus . BswMJ1939DcmChannelRef parameter. For rule processing, the BswM shall use the value in NetworkMask of the bit (0 or 1) which lies in the position configured by the referenced ComMChannel . ComMChannelId .
